messages.en: I felt a bit hurt when he made fun of me in the group chat earlier.
I get it. Even when you're joking, you've got to think about other people's feelings, right? Want me to come with you to talk to him?
Yeah, but let's leave it till tomorrow. Right now, I just want to calm down.
